source: hand-computed from events.json; not computed by any TravelPlan or abkit code

definitions.dau: Number of distinct non-null userId with at least one event on a UTC calendar date. occurredAt is converted to UTC before bucketing; anonymous events (userId null) are excluded.
definitions.funnel: Per non-null userId, over the whole log, ordered by occurredAt: a user reaches step k only after reaching step k-1 at an earlier or equal time. Counts are users per step.

traps: The anonymous wizard_started on 2026-11-01 counts for neither DAU nor the funnel.
user_c saves a trip without any trip_generation_completed, so user_c stops at step 2.
